On the absence front, Florian Grillitsch has yet to recover from a thigh problem, but left-back Gabriele Bracaglia can return after serving a one-match ban.

While Parma will welcome back Abdoulaye Ndiaye from suspension, Argentine striker David Romero is still ruled out by a serious shoulder injury; defensive duo Diego Carlos (thigh) and Dominik Drobnic (foot) are also doubts. While Parma's attacking output has been limited this season, El Bilal Toure and Nesta Elphege are expected to start up front and could trouble an inconsistent Frosinone defence.

David Romero remains unavailable for the visitors, who will need to improve considerably on their defensive display against Roma to leave Frosinone with a positive result.

## Frosinone vs Parma form guide & betting tips [...] Nevertheless, Massimiliano Alvini's side remain seventh in the Serie A standings, just one point behind Juventus, and will welcome a return to familiar surroundings.

The Canarini recorded a 5-1 victory over Lecce before beating Torino 2-0 in their two most recent appearances at the Stadio Benito Stirpe.

The absence of Antonio Raimondo is a significant blow for the hosts, with Tomas Bobcek expected to lead the line as Daniel Birligea is also unavailable. [...] - Frosinone have won their last five home Serie A matches.
